direction: Long-horizon daily BTC/ETH SMA trend-following with a symmetric hysteresis band.
hypothesis: Longer 150-300-day trend filters may suppress short-horizon whipsaws; a predeclared 0-1% symmetric band may improve net results by reducing marginal crossings, at the cost of later entries/exits.
logic: For daily decision index i, compare completed close C[i-1] to the arithmetic mean of C[i-lookback:i], all fully closed UTC daily bars. If flat, enter when C[i-1] > SMA*(1+band). If long, exit when C[i-1] < SMA*(1-band). Otherwise preserve the prior desired state. New OOS account starts flat; no warm-up fills or pre-OOS state replay.
allocation: Each config is a separate 2,000 USDT account with a single BTC or ETH sleeve; the full amount is the maximum risky sleeve, no leverage, no transfers, no rebalancing, and no cross-config averaging.

evidence_review.finding: All 16 exact initial registry rows already have actual backtest/report evidence; do not rerun completed exact configs.
evidence_review.freqtrade_trial_results: Read backtest-result metadata and three walk-forward JSON reports; their 2026-07-21 through 2026-09-15 15m results are not the present daily long-horizon configs.

source.title: Trend-following Strategies for Crypto Investors, section 4.1
source.use: Long-only moving-average trend rule; 150/200-day horizons follow cited horizon set, 250/300 are predeclared extensions.

development_data.reuse_disclosure: The same 2024-09-16 through 2026-09-16 Binance history has appeared in prior research. It is development/validation history, not an untouched final holdout.

walk_forward.parameter_fit: None. Rules are frozen before results; prior daily closes are used only for SMA warm-up and signals.
walk_forward.oos_trade_dates_utc: 2025-09-19 through 2026-09-13; terminal execution at next available 00:01 UTC minute open.

cost_model.impact_formula: 0.5 * prior-20-complete-UTC-day sample volatility * sqrt(order budget / prior-20-day mean quote ADV)
cost_model.spread_observation: Historical one-minute OHLCV has no historical L2 quotes; half-spread is an estimate and is charged once.
cost_model.execution_model: Historical executable reference is the next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open, after the completed prior daily close is available. Decimal28 fill, adverse tick, LOT_SIZE/NOTIONAL, 5-minute VWAP proxy, and participation checks are reused from the repository execution kernel. Simulated fills are not exchange acceptance guarantees.

failure_gates.interpretation: Passed means this repeated historical walk-forward screen only; it is not independent or live-profit evidence.
